Create a clean, lowercase URL slug from a title. This free online url slug generator gives you an instant answer without an account, a download or sending your entries to a server. It is designed for quick everyday use on desktop and mobile. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the URL Slug Generator

Start by typing or pasting your page title. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults. The steps below walk through each input in order.

1. Type or paste your page title.
2. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
3. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Words are lowercased, punctuation removed and gaps replaced with hyphens.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [URL Slug Generator](/slug-generator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Check the units and labels before comparing results.
- Your entries stay in your browser and are not saved.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

Words are lowercased, punctuation removed and gaps replaced with hyphens. You can see it in action in the [URL Slug Generator](/slug-generator) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.
